ui_default_blurb: Composer 2.5 Standard is the orchestrator parent: you talk to Composer; it spawns Job-table models for build/review/premier work. Prefer Standard (not Fast). Do not use Auto — Auto silent-routes mid-protocol and defeats Job routing.
tier_notes: Premier = Claude Opus 5.5 (hard gates). Everyday implement/review A = Grok 4.7. Second family = Claude Sonnet 5.5. Cheap = Composer (parent/walkthrough/sweeps). Prefer Standard / medium — avoid Fast unless latency-blocked. OpenAI (Terra/Sol/Luna) removed from defaults after Cursor OpenAI wind-down (~Nov 2026); BYOK local only if you still want GPT.
routing_rule: Parent = Composer orchestrator → spawn Job slugs. Hard-to-reverse judgment → Premier (Opus). Everyday build + routine Loop A → Grok 4.7; Loop B → Sonnet. Routine Loop C skipped unless large/messy diff. Cheap/wide/walkthrough → Composer. Design competition → Gemini Flash + Grok + Sonnet. Facts → CodeGraph. Harden with Spec gate + expectation checklists.
